digest.component_or_area: Git reclaim-backup helper and manifest preparation
propositions: Prepare an off-repository Git bundle and JSON manifest containing the old tickets tip and requested pin-ref OIDs without performing any remote ref deletion or push
Enumerate live origin heads and tags at run time, collapse annotated-tag peeled lines, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs plus old-tip ancestry relationships for each commit ref
Refuse partial/promisor clones, pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ namespaces, and output destinations inside the repository or registered worktrees; perform no remote mutation
Verify the bundle with git bundle verify, restore it into a throwaway repository, and confirm restored old-tip and pin-tip OIDs exactly match the manifest before cleanup
